name: TUR Stake spot-priced power and unaccrued referral power
summary: Stake priced new power from spot TUR/NOBEL and NOBEL/USDT reserves and credited 20%/5% of it to the staker's referrers without updating their rewardDebt, so they could at once claim it times the whole accumulated reward. With 1.9M flash-loaned USDT the attacker pumped both prices, staked under its own referrer accounts and claimed the 18.8M TUR reward balance.
notes: The project deployer's top-level creation installed the non-upgradeable Stake runtime; the constructor fixed both pair addresses used for pricing, and the runtime hash was unchanged through the exploit.

Stake lost 18.8M TUR; less the 3% claim fee to the fund wallet and the attacker's own 840,992 TUR stake, 18,207,873.54 TUR went to the referrers. Its dump moved the price, so it is valued at the realised 133,398.30 USDT gain (rule 15); 76,303 USDT NOBEL's own fee swap sent to its tax wallet is not counted.
